name: Fox River Grove (United States)
description: Blue saltire with white quarters above and below and green quarters at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with a dark red shield bearing an orange fox's head.
history: Fox River Grove is a village in McHenry and Lake counties, Illinois. Flags of the World records that the design by Dominic Cimilluca, an eighth-grader at Fox River Grove Middle School, won the village's centennial flag contest and now flies at Village Hall.

features.role: shield with an orange fox's head
